    Loading the payroll…

    Gross pay = trips × rate (trips as driver + trips as helper), or days worked × rate when the rate is per day. Trips are counted like the Dashboard: every leg is one trip, planned and running trips count, cancelled and NO TRIP don't. Advances are the trip budgets sent in these dates; they come off pay only when "Deduct trip budgets from pay" is on. Tap a name to see the trips.
